title: Safe RLHF-V: Safe Reinforcement Learning from Multi-modal Human Feedback
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety alignment for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), introducing a dataset and framework to evaluate and mitigate harmful behaviors based on a detailed taxonomy of 'harmful and unethical themes.' The harmlessness evaluation criteria specifically include factors like 'moral responsibility' and 'ethical concerns' when scoring model responses.
